Ethan M: Quick flag  CloudWave says invoice INV-2027-01-05-CW didn’t include agreed promo cap. They expected 10% off up to $10k; looks like system applied 10% on only one SKU. Can we review?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2027-01-05-CW posted 2027-01-05 09:10Z. Total: $9,450.00. Status: paid. PDF: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2027-01-05-CW

Rina (Acct): pasted invoice lines:
```
acct,description,qty,unit_price,line_total
CW-44,Hosted inference - usage,1,8000.00,8000.00
CW-44,Support - basic,1,1500.00,1500.00
```
Promo terms: 10% off combined recurring up to $10,000 cap. System applied 10% only to usage line (-800.00) and not to support. Customer expected -950.00 (10% of 9,500) but capped at 10% of 10k = 1,000 max would not be hit. So correct promo should be -950.00 across taxable lines.

Ethan M: Net difference = 150.00. Tax region CA tax 7.25% applied to support only. Tax on support is currently 108.75. If promo applied across both lines, tax reduces slightly. Full credit required = 150.00 + tax delta ~ 10.88 = 160.88 (rounding).

Rina (Acct): Proposal: CM for -160.88, adj code FIN-PROMO-2027-09. Apply to posted invoice and refund if customer prefers CC. Need Dir Finance OK.

Priya (Dir Finance): Approved. Small goodwill credit OK. Post CM-2027-200 for -160.88. GL: Revenue Contra 4010; Tax Liability adjust 2410.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2027-200 created and applied to INV-2027-01-05-CW. Amount: -160.88. Status: applied. Reference FIN-PROMO-2027-09.

Payments: No refund requested; credit applied to account for next invoice.

Ethan M: Noted. I’ll add a QA case to ensure promo coverage includes all recurring SKUs. Closing after next invoice shows credit consumption.
